description: WebDavClient's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json), so this one line is the whole adoption - the same shape every consumer uses.

Without it Renovate ran here on its defaults: the git-submodules manager off, so third_party/ANTfrastructure was never watched, and no lockFileMaintenance, so uv.lock sat 41 packages behind on 2026-10-07 while every manager reported nothing.

The Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository (family owner decision, 2026-09-09). ANTfrastructure's linux/scripts/renovate-local.sh reads exactly this file; .github/dependabot.yml stays until that hand-over is decided.
